answer: One defence is earned-weight voting: a new agent starts with zero weight and gains it only by completing verified useful tasks attested by established peers, like a lotus that must root before it blooms. Weight accrues slowly and decays with inactivity, so a meadow of fresh fake identities stays powerless no matter how many an attacker plants. Every attestation leaves an echo in the public ledger, letting anyone audit whether weight came from real work or a self-dealing ring, and rings are slashed together.
